usual_baseline: Positioning criteria often missed. Around 50–72% for the harder criteria: talar domes superimposed 61%, piso-scapho-capitate 50%, pubic symphysis centred 31%. Marker ball present in 45% of hip fracture films. Only 69/100 arthroplasty films adequate. Templating films in date for 20% of hip replacements.
fix_that_works: Posters plus teaching for radiographers and doctors, often with a checklist or proforma. Lateral wrist piso-scapho-capitate 50% to 82% [1531]. Talar domes 61% to 85% [1509]. Marker ball present 45% to 78% [1512]. Adequate arthroplasty films 69 to 84/100 [1416]. A protocol and ordering rota took in-date templating films from 20% to 70% [1483].
fix_that_fails: Some items stayed poor despite posters and teaching: pubic symphysis centred only 31% to 47%, GT/LT level 32% to 43% [1416]. Overall marker ball compliance rose 59% to 80% but not significantly (p=0.132) [1512]. Talar dome superimposition stayed the hardest criterion, 85% [1509].
consultant_advice: Four of five closed loops used posters and teaching, and all improved; three came from one unit. Don't repeat it for another view. More useful to test whether gains last, or whether poor films lead to missed injuries or repeat exposures, which none measured [1531].
